titulo: Prevention of Iron Deficiency Anemia Post-delivery

braco.texto: Participants randomized to the oral iron arm will receive 60 mg elemental iron twice daily. Treatment will be initiated between 6-48 hours after delivery and prior to discharge from the facility. After discharge, each participant will take a treatment dose of twice daily for 6 weeks postpartum. titulo: Evaluation of Sarilumab (SAR153191/REGN88) on Top of Methotrexate in Rheumatoid Arthritis Patients

braco.texto: Sarilumab 100 mg qw, 150 mg qw or 100 mg q2w SC injections as in Part A on top of MTX up to dose selection. After dose selection, participants were not continued but were allowed to participate in the open-label, long-term, extension study SARIL-RA-EXTEND (LTS11210).
braco.textoPt: Sarilumabe 100 mg qw, 150 mg qw ou 100 mg q2w injeções SC como na Parte A além do MTX até a seleção da dose. Após a seleção da dose, os participantes não continuaram, mas foram autorizados a participar do estudo de extensão aberto e de longo prazo SARIL-RA-EXTEND (LTS11210).
braco.nomePt: Parte B Coorte 1: Doses Não Selecionadas

trechos: Sarilumab 100 mg SC injection every other week (q2w) alternating with placebo on top of MTX for 12 weeks.
After dose selection, participants were not continued but were allowed to participate in the open-label, long-term, extension study SARIL-RA-EXTEND (LTS11210).
trechosPt: Sarilumabe 100 mg injeção SC a cada duas semanas (q2w) alternando com placebo além de MTX por 12 semanas.
Após a seleção da dose, os participantes não continuaram, mas foram autorizados a participar do estudo de extensão aberto e de longo prazo SARIL-RA-EXTEND (LTS11210).

tituloPt: Avaliação de sarilumabe (SAR153191/REGN88) além de metotrexato em pacientes com artrite reumatóide
